initial_replay_file_hash_provenance: The source_sha256 values in parity.json were read from disk at report finalization. The loaded numeric implementation is preserved at results/streaming_sampler_at_first_run.py. During the replay only input validation was tightened, without changes to numerical operations for valid arguments. Final tests and final-cost use final sources.
parity_scope: Every scored archived41x41 ROI pixel for all280 scenes, six arms and two tile budgets. Not a full-frame parity assertion.
cost_scope: Shared host, CPU only, explicit one thread per library, includes preparation. Streaming is slower and has bounded coordinate memory. Additional evidence has cost. No GPU or isolated production latency claim.

axis_control.scope: Exact area of a source-cell constant reconstruction under diagonal affine maps only. Different reconstruction model from bilinear. No general rectification or radiometric claim.
axis_control.development_status: Positive control developed after the independent fixed-grid counterexample. This is failure-directed development, not an unseen validation bank.

implementation_scope: Offline NumPy/OpenCV only, outside torch training hot path.
